explanation: The execution contains a provenance identity fault. Job 1 selected and handed off the needs records with record_ids n06-r01 through n06-r08, but its evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values. That breaks the downstream rank join, so Job 2 cannot recover upstream provenance ranks and emits upstream_rank: 0 for every priority.
cited_evidence: The supplied assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the demand record_id with the source_id.
Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while Job 2 input needs contains record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
The supplied prioritize source builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources['record_id'] and looks it up using coverage['record_id']; the observed priorities all have upstream_rank: 0.
